title: NICSI Undertakes Cleanliness and Pendency Reduction Activities Under Special Campaign 6.0
subtitle: Campaign Improves Workplace Cleanliness and Hygiene, Frees Space Occupied by Obsolete and Unused Material
body_text: National Informatics Centre Services Incorporated (NICSI), a Government of India Enterprise under the National Informatics Centre (NIC), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), conducted Special Campaign 6.0 for Swachhata and pendency reduction across its establishments in Delhi-NCR. The campaign focused on promoting workplace cleanliness, removal of obsolete material, optimisation of office space and improvement in record management. It began with a cleanliness pledge by NICSI officers and staff, followed by cleanliness and related activities across its locations. As part of the campaign, general office cleaning was undertaken at NICSI Headquarters at Bhikaji Cama Place, Delhi. At NICSI Headquarters at WTC, unwanted material was removed and the external area was cleaned. Indoor and outdoor cleaning, including corridors, common areas and washrooms, was undertaken at NICSI, New Delhi and SPDC, Noida. Office and common areas were cleaned at LNDC, while unwanted items were removed and corridors and washrooms were cleaned at SPDC. Old and unused items were also removed across all locations. The campaign improved workplace cleanliness and hygiene and freed space occupied by obsolete and unused material. NICSI will sustain the outcomes of the campaign through regular housekeeping, periodic record review and weeding, and timely disposal of unserviceable assets in accordance with applicable rules. *** Vinod Kumar / Kanishk Sharma
